name: arXiv
summary: Search and look up arXiv preprints (titles, authors, abstracts, categories, links) through arXiv's free query API.
notes: Keyless and free; read the arXiv API Terms of Use. Put a 3-second delay between repeated calls.
Answers are Atom 1.0 XML, not JSON; errors also come back as an Atom feed with one entry. Totals are in opensearch:totalResults.
Results change only after new articles are announced (after midnight), so cache a query for the day.
At most 2,000 results per call and 30,000 per query overall; use OAI-PMH for bulk harvesting.

endpoints.name: Search or look up arXiv papers
endpoints.summary: Papers matching a field-prefixed query and/or a list of arXiv IDs.

search_query.description: Query with field prefixes ti, au, abs, co, jr, cat, rn, all; AND, OR, ANDNOT; quotes for phrases; submittedDate:[YYYYMMDDTTTT TO YYYYMMDDTTTT] (GMT).

id_list.description: Comma-separated arXiv IDs. With search_query, returns the listed IDs that also match.

start.description: 0-based index of the first result, default 0.

max_results.description: Results per call, default 10, at most 2000.

notes: Look up papers by ID with id_list rather than an id: query.
Page with start and max_results; a request beyond 30,000 results answers 400.
